title: Comfort Club Upkeep Multiplier on the Replacement System Installations Progress Installment
content:
# Upkeep multiplier on the progress installment

**Rule.** The upkeep factor of a Replacement System Installations progress installment follows the Comfort Club tune-up visits completed on the homeowner's agreement — as recorded in the Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements visit history — in the 24 months before the date of handling, never counting a visit forfeited for a missed or late-cancelled appointment:

| Completed tune-up visits in the 24 months | The progress share amount is multiplied by |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 0.8 |
| At least 2 but fewer than 4 | 0.9 |
| Fewer than 2 | 1.0 |

## What counts as a visit

- A tune-up visit recorded as completed on the agreement counts.
- A visit forfeited because the appointment was missed or cancelled late does not count.
- Only visits dated in the 24 months before the date of handling count.

## Cases (hypothetical visit histories)

- Five completed tune-ups in the last 24 months: multiplied by 0.8.
- Three completed tune-ups and one forfeited visit in the last 24 months: three count, so multiplied by 0.9.
- Exactly 2 completed tune-ups: multiplied by 0.9.
- One completed tune-up in the last 24 months and three more 30 months ago: one counts, so multiplied by 1.0.
